## How it works

<h3>Try it</h3>
<ol><li>Open Files (folder) on the left toolbar to see the seven IFC4 models in the federation.</li><li>Toggle file checkboxes to inspect architecture, structure, mechanical, plumbing, electrical, fire alarm and sprinkler models in their shared coordinates.</li><li>Select a component, then click 1 element selected at the top left to open Properties.</li></ol>
<h3>About this example</h3>
<p>For BIM users reviewing a multidisciplinary hospital project. The seven IFC4 files from the linked West Riverside Hospital folder are imported unchanged into one viewer, with their original names and placements. The complete download is approximately 224 MB; allow time and memory for all models to open.</p>
<p>The standalone page reads its source list once and adds files sequentially through the published SDK. Download feedback and errors use the viewer's message API. Retry sample resumes with the first unfinished file and retains files already imported.</p>
<p>Copy this folder and serve it over HTTP, for example <code>python -m http.server 8080</code>. Open <code>http://localhost:8080/</code>; the SDK and sample downloads require internet access.</p>
